scripts-descriptions.sy: Framework installer: install, sync, build, db, doctor
scripts-descriptions.db: Run the database migrations: composer db [migrate|info|repair|clean|validate|baseline]
scripts-descriptions.build: Rebuild the CSS and JS assets
scripts-descriptions.doctor: Diagnose the project: missing plugin files, compiled CSS, database configuration
scripts-descriptions.install-project: Full project installation (alias of composer sy install)
scripts-descriptions.install-plugin: Plugin installation: composer install-plugin [PLUGIN NAME] [OPTIONAL VERSION]
scripts-descriptions.format: Format the PHP coding style: composer format [FILE OR DIRECTORY]
scripts-descriptions.check: Check the PHP coding style: composer check [FILE OR DIRECTORY]
scripts-descriptions.chown: Give the current user back the files created as root by the Docker build (WSL)

sy.build: id -nG "$USER" | grep -qw docker && SUDO=sudo;$SUDO docker run --pull always --rm -v "$PWD":/syproject -w /syproject node:slim /bin/bash -c "npm install;npm install -g gulp-cli;gulp build" && sudo chown -R "$USER" assets

host.question: SMTP hostname (An IP address or FQDN of the SMTP server)

username.question: SMTP user (User name used to connect to the SMTP server. Leave empty if no authentication is required)

password.question: SMTP password (Password of the SMTP user. Leave empty if no authentication is required)

encryption.question: Encryption (Usually tls on port 587 and ssl on port 465)
